source: Owner-supplied Archive.org H.264 listing for the 208-program Wild Kingdom Channel 2 batch; exact MP4 paths are taken from the uploaded listing. Existing entries and URLs are preserved.
playback_verification: The owner reports the three direct Twilight Zone samples play. Directory entries and the other supplied links are not a full playback test. No movie or episode was downloaded for this change.
notes: Season 2 episode 27 has a separate listed v2 MP4; both files are retained with the alternate explicitly labeled.
MP4 entries only. MKV versions, images, metadata, torrent files, and thumbnails are not programming.
Existing programs and URLs are preserved. The former Channel 2 catalog is moved intact to Channel 27; new Wild Kingdom programs are added to Channel 2.
Wild Kingdom Channel 2 now contains the 208 programs from the owner's supplied 208-show list, matched to the uploaded Archive.org H.264 listing.
